- workflow-templates/.claude/settings.json:145 registers the `prepush_affected_tests.py hook` Bash PreToolUse entry; .claude/settings.json has no prepush_affected_tests entry | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The live settings file and its template differ because the live file lacks the `prepush_affected_tests.py` hook.

- Requirement: "Claude in every role (phase 3)". The last run's changelog line says the six newly allowed workflows "get no pool credential until the Worker is redeployed with `wrangler deploy`".
  Expected change site: Deployment of tools/claude-pool-broker, which includes the six workflows the last run added to ALLOWED_WORKFLOW_FILES at tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:69-86.
  Evidence of absence: No workflow in the repository deploys the broker. CLAUDE.md §24.C makes the deploy a session or operator action. Until it happens, those workflows get no credential. Under the default AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY=capacity, no_credential is refused with exit 76 (scripts/ai_engine.sh, ai_engine_no_account_reason followed by ai_engine_fallback), so validate, workflow-failure-heal-intake, check-triage, activation-verify and log-analysis fail closed instead of running codex. This is an operator activation step, not a code defect. It should appear in the PR body or as an ai:operator-step entry so that merging this PR is followed by the deploy.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml, lines 1105-1203 ("Run standalone stall recovery without active projects" step env block) compared with lines 917-1003 ("Process each tracking issue" step env block) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The standalone recovery sweep env omits five variables present in the full poller step: `SECURITY_AUDIT_LINE_OWNERSHIP` (line 934 in full), `SECURITY_AUDIT_LINE_OWNERSHIP_HUNK_WINDOW` (line 935), `SECURITY_PASS_AUDIT_CLEAN_WORKTREE_ENABLED` (line 939), `AI_ENGINE_ACTIVATION_VERIFY` (line 950), and `NEEDS_HUMAN_DIGEST_ENABLED` (line 956).
  WHY: `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py:235` asserts `sweep_env == full["env"]` after popping `STANDALONE_RECOVERY_SWEEP_ONLY`, failing the current head; idle ticks also use script-level defaults instead of repo-configured values.
- .claude/settings.json, lines 99-140 (PreToolUse hook entries) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The live settings file contains 4 PreToolUse hook entries, while `workflow-templates/.claude/settings.json` contains 5 entries; the template adds a Bash matcher running `python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py hook, which the live file does not have.
  WHY: `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py::test_template_copies_are_identical` and `tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py` assert that `TEMPLATE_SETTINGS_PATH.read_text()` equals `SETTINGS_PATH.read_text()`. The current head has them diverging, which fails the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` and `tests-release-and-log-analysis` CI jobs; consumer repos would otherwise receive a hook the source sessions lack.

- Requirement: "feat: Unattended Claude pipeline completion: Claude in every role (phase 3) and blocker reduction (phase 4)" — the PR title requires Claude to run every role by default. The LAST RUN DIFF updates `tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts` to add six workflow filenames (`check_failure_triage.yml`, `issue_pr_status.yml`, `validate.yml`, `validation-refresh.yml`, `workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml`, `workflow-log-analysis.yml`) to `ALLOWED_WORKFLOW_FILES`, and `changelog.d/validate-roles-claude-engine.md` explicitly states "these workflows get no pool credential until the Worker is redeployed with `wrangler deploy` (CLAUDE.md §24.C)".
  Expected change site: A single `wrangler deploy` invocation (or a repository_dispatch that triggers it) that ships the updated `tools/claude-pool-broker` Worker code to Cloudflare. The unattended pipeline does not contain any workflow that deploys `tools/claude-pool-broker` to Cloudflare; only an interactive operator session can do it under CLAUDE.md §24.C.
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff (LAST RUN + PR) touches `tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts` but no deployment workflow, no `repository_dispatch` payload, and no manual step in a workflow file. The last-run editor summary acknowledges this ("The broker only uses the new list after the Worker is redeployed... until then those six workflows get no pool credential."). Under the default `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY=capacity`, a `no_credential` refusal is exit 76 and fails the step (see `scripts/ai_engine.sh:218-220, 241-244`), so the just-enabled Claude-default roles in those six workflows will fail closed until the broker is redeployed.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
